description: Insertion target rules: container/leaf/page/climb and 'after' placement (utils/structureEditing.test.ts).

Layer name helpers: default-name detection, suggestions from binding/label/token, inner-layer rename planning (utils/structureEditing.layerNames.test.ts).
Store paste/duplicate: fresh ids, AST id dropped, invalid parent refused, unique names, delete re-selection (state/designerStore.pasteSubtree.test.ts).

Store paste style replaces visual style and container layout, leaves size, undoes in one step; first-free default names; header preset bindings and translations (state/designerStore.pasteStyle.test.ts).
New blocks are content-sized and media keep frames (state/designerStore.layout.test.ts, designerStore.addNodeFromPalette.test.ts).

AST authoring round-trips: layer names, no names for shipped templates, logo binding export/import, column widths/alignment, translated defaults for tables/totals, text translation then fixed text (ast/workspaceAst.authoring.test.ts).
Canonical binding ids for designed tables and logo import as Logo block (ast/workspaceAst.test.ts).

Auto-link of exact standard text and persistent fixed-text opt-out (utils/translatableText.autoLink.test.ts).
Default field format and logo render path per document kind (fields/documentBindingCatalog.defaultFormat.test.ts).
'Set' means differs from a new block's default; empty values are unset (inspector/fieldState.test.ts).
Rounded tables render with separate borders; square tables keep collapsed borders (lib/invoice-template-ast/react-renderer.tableCorners.test.tsx).

Spacing controls: per-side padding inputs, shorthand parsing, independent sides by default, 'Same on all sides', clearing one side (inspector/DesignerSchemaInspector.spacingControls.integration.test.tsx).
Schema inspector: live-typing an emptied field stays empty and blur unsets it; example placeholders (inspector/DesignerSchemaInspector.integration.test.tsx).
Unified Size control sets width/height by mode and typed value; no X/Y inputs (DesignerShell.sharedSizing.integration.test.tsx).

Canvas media aspect and hover badge (canvas/DesignCanvas.mediaAspect.integration.test.tsx).

Shortcut catalog contract keeps designer shortcuts editor-scoped (packages/ui keyboard-shortcuts tests).
Translation validation passes for all locales (node scripts/validate-translations.cjs).

Usability acceptance: an evaluator rebuilds the Detailed invoice layout from a blank layout via UI operations only; saved AST matches the source; three consecutive ratings >= 8/10 (manual, recorded in SCRATCHPAD.md).
